prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic full-body cosplay portrait of Soara, a young fantasy craftswoman adventurer standing confidently in a low-angle hero pose on a grassy rocky hillside. She has long silver-gray hair tied into a high side ponytail with a large dark brown bow, soft bangs framing her face, pale skin, and a calm serious expression. Dress her in a dark forest-green military-style tunic dress with gold piping, high collar, long sleeves with wide cuffs, double rows of brass buttons, a brown leather belt, shoulder straps, black textured tights, and tall dark brown leather boots with light shearling cuffs. Add exactly 5 visible carried/tool elements: 1 large adjustable wrench in her left hand, 1 wooden mallet in her right hand, 1 blue leather tool pouch at her hip holding metal hand tools, 1 brown backpack strapped to her back, and 1 cluster of metal tools protruding from the backpack. The setting is a whimsical medieval-fantasy artisan village beside a massive ancient tree, with a cozy workshop doorway carved into the tree trunk on the right, a small round-roofed cottage and wooden balcony structures in the midground, scattered barrels and workshop clutter, distant green mountains, rocks, grass, and a bright cloudy sky. Use natural warm daylight, soft haze, shallow depth of field, highly detailed fabric and leather textures, realistic skin, wind-tossed hair strands, muted earthy colors, epic fantasy realism, vertical 4:5 composition, no text, no watermark, no anime line art.
